Account: mid-market billing SaaS that powers subscription billing + dunning for vertical SaaS customers. Primary ask: replace brittle rule-based support workflows with a streaming chat agent that can call Stripe/Zuora APIs and return strict JSON payloads for downstream systems.

Technical preferences: prefer Llama-2 style open models but open to Redwood-curated variants. Interested in automatic fallback policies: hosted->dedicated->quantized smaller model for cold-starts. Need deterministic structured output; ask about RLHF/regression monitoring hooks.

Misc: referenced drive pricing deck; legal sent standard DPAs but wants PCI addendum. Competitive evaluation: internal infra team proof-of-concept, OpenAI Rapid + functions.

AE summary: qualified technical buy; primary risk = security & latency SLA language. SE will run POC runbook and synthetic latency tests during pilot.
